title: Gucci Mage in Neon Abyss
description: A man in ornate dark blue and red Gucci-inspired armor crouches dynamically in the foreground, holding a glowing circular emblem with the interlocking GG logo. Behind him on a wooden pier stand five mysterious figures in black suits and top hats under a fiery red and purple apocalyptic sky, surrounded by large blue spiked orbs with glowing green symbols scattered across the wet ground.
